register_map.notes: SPI uses 1-byte register addressing with multi-byte bit for burst reads/writes.

read_channels.notes: X-axis acceleration, two's complement, LSB first.
Y-axis acceleration, two's complement, LSB first.
Z-axis acceleration, two's complement, LSB first.

access_model.notes: SPI: first byte contains R/W bit, multi-byte bit, and 6-bit register address. Data follows.

preconditions: Power-up with V_S and V_DD_I/O applied.

steps.notes: Clear measure bit (D3) to enter standby mode.

operation_flows.notes: Device powers up in standby mode by default; this step ensures standby.

steps.notes: Set measure bit (D3) to 1 to enter measurement mode.

operation_flows.notes: After this, device starts measuring at default 100 Hz ODR.

steps.notes: SPI: first byte 0xF2 = R/W=1, MB=1, address 0x32. Read 6 bytes: DATAX0, DATAX1, DATAY0, DATAY1, DATAZ0, DATAZ1.

operation_flows.notes: Multiple-byte read recommended to avoid data change between registers.

preconditions: Device in measurement mode, normal power, ODR 100-800 Hz or 3200 Hz.

steps.notes: Set data rate to 100 Hz (0x0A) and ensure LOW_POWER=0.
Read and average 10 samples with self-test disabled; store as X_ST_OFF, Y_ST_OFF, Z_ST_OFF.
Set SELF_TEST bit (D7) to 1 to enable self-test.
Wait for output to settle (about 4 samples at 100 Hz = 40 ms).
Read and average same number of samples with self-test enabled; store as X_ST_ON, Y_ST_ON, Z_ST_ON.

operation_flows.notes: Self-test change = output with self-test enabled minus output with self-test disabled.

preconditions: Device in measurement mode, full-resolution mode.

steps.notes: Measure X0g, Y0g, Z+1g by averaging 10 samples at 100 Hz with device oriented appropriately.
Calculate offset register values: XOFFSET = -Round(X0g/4), YOFFSET = -Round(Y0g/4), ZOFFSET = -Round((Z+1g - 256)/4) for full-resolution.

operation_flows.notes: Offset registers automatically added to acceleration data.

steps.notes: Read INT_SOURCE to clear non-data-related interrupts.
Read data registers to clear DATA_READY, watermark, and overrun bits.

operation_flows.notes: Reading INT_SOURCE clears tap, activity, inactivity, free-fall interrupts. Reading data clears data-related interrupts.

raw_encoding.notes: Data registers are 16-bit two's complement, LSB first. In full-resolution mode, scale factor is 3.9 mg/LSB, resolution increases with g range (up to 13 bits at ±16g).

init_sequence.notes: Power-up: apply V_S and V_DD_I/O. Device enters standby mode by default.
Configure device registers as needed (e.g., data format, interrupts, FIFO) while in standby.
Set measure bit to enter measurement mode.
Wait for first valid data: at 100 Hz ODR, turn-on time is approximately 11.1 ms.

read_sequence.notes: SPI: send 0xF2 (R/W=1, MB=1, address 0x32), then read 6 bytes: DATAX0, DATAX1, DATAY0, DATAY1, DATAZ0, DATAZ1.
Combine each axis's two bytes (LSB first) into signed 16-bit raw value.

conversion_formulae.name: accel_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: acceleration_g = raw_value * scale_factor, where scale_factor depends on range and mode. In full-resolution mode, scale_factor = 3.9 mg/LSB (0.0039 g/LSB). In 10-bit mode, scale_factor = range/512 g/LSB (e.g., ±2g: 3.9 mg/LSB, ±4g: 7.8 mg/LSB, ±8g: 15.6 mg/LSB, ±16g: 31.2 mg/LSB).

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit two's complement raw value for axis x.

conversion_formulae.name: self_test_change
conversion_formulae.formula: X_ST = X_ST_ON - X_ST_OFF (in LSB). Convert to g using scale factor.

inputs.name: st_on
inputs.byte_source: average of samples with self-test enabled
inputs.description: Average raw value with self-test enabled.

inputs.name: st_off
inputs.byte_source: average of samples with self-test disabled
inputs.description: Average raw value with self-test disabled.

conversion_formulae.name: offset_calculation_fullres
conversion_formulae.formula: XOFFSET = -Round(X0g / 4) in LSB of offset register (15.6 mg/LSB).

evidence_spans.snippet: Clearing the SPI bit (Bit D6) in the DATA_FORMAT register (Address 0x31) selects 4-wire mode, whereas setting the SPI bit selects 3-wire mode.
The maximum SPI clock speed is 5 MHz with 100 pF maximum loading, and the timing scheme follows clock polarity (CPOL) = 1 and clock phase (CPHA) = 1.
Table 10. SPI Timing (TA = 25°C, VS = 2.5 V, VDD I/O = 1.8 V)
The DATA_FORMAT register controls the presentation of data to Register 0x32 through Register 0x37.
The output data is twos complement, with DATAx0 as the least significant byte and DATAx1 as the most significant byte.
When the self-test function is enabled (via the SELF_TEST bit in the DATA_FORMAT register, Address 0x31), an electrostatic force is exerted on the mechanical sensor.
After VS is applied, the device enters standby mode, where power consumption is minimized and the device waits for VDD I/O to be applied and for the command to enter measurement mode to be received.

requires_human: Offset calibration requires system-specific orientation and averaging; values depend on application.
Self-test limits depend on supply voltage; scale factors from Table 14 must be applied for voltages other than 2.5 V.
FIFO mode and trigger configuration require application-specific decisions.
